reason: A DSH plugin that monitors session events and sends configurable completion, failure, approval, and waiting-state notifications to an iPhone through a Bark Server, with Host-side configuration and a browser settings panel.

summaries.zh: 监听 DSH 会话事件，并通过用户配置的 Bark Server 向 iPhone 推送任务完成、失败、审批和等待状态通知。
summaries.en: Monitors DSH session events and sends configurable completion, failure, approval, and waiting-state notifications to an iPhone through a user-configured Bark Server.

capabilities: sends HTTP push notifications to a configured Bark URL
provides a browser settings page using loopback RPC
stores the Bark URL in Host-side settings
